title: Sr Engineer, Applications Development - SAP Hybris
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------


Implements tactical and operational goals focused on software build, release, deployment, and configuration management, ensuring seamless application delivery. Contributes to the implementation of new automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, testing methodologies, and deployment standards. Manages software deployment projects and operational processes, coordinating release schedules, dependency tracking, and integration workflows. Works on diverse, multifaceted challenges where analysis requires evaluating software performance, system compatibility, and implementation risks. Derives solutions based on limited precedent, applying best practices in release engineering, infrastructure automation, and software quality assurance to maintain stability and efficiency. Communicates regularly with internal stakeholders, including development, QA, IT operations, and product teams, as well as external vendors and cloud service providers to ensure timely implementation and support.**Senior SAP Hybris Developer:**

 **Role Overview:**

  

As a Senior member of the e\-commerce technology team, the developer will design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure e\-commerce solutions using SAP Hybris and manage junior members.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Architect \& Lead E\-commerce Platforms:**  

Design and drive scalable, high\-performance, and secure end\-to\-end e\-commerce architectures aligned with enterprise strategy, industry best practices, and long\-term business goals.
* **Technical Leadership \& Solution Design:**  

Lead the design and development of complex e\-commerce solutions using SAP Commerce Cloud (SAP CC), Java, Spartacus/Angular, Node.js, Spring Framework, and modern microservices\-based architectures.
* **Enterprise Integration Strategy:**  

Architect and oversee seamless integrations with enterprise ecosystems including ERP, CRM, payment gateways, SSO, middleware, and external third\-party services, ensuring reliability and scalability.
* **Domain Expertise \& Optimization:**  

Provide deep functional and technical expertise across core e\-commerce domains such as customer profiles, product catalog, shopping cart, checkout flows, payments, pricing, quotes, and order management systems.
* **Cross\-functional Leadership:**  

Partner with business stakeholders (marketing, sales, finance, product, and IT leadership) to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and drive digital transformation initiatives.
* **Mentorship \& Team Development:**  

Mentor and guide junior and mid\-level developers, enforce coding standards, conduct design reviews, and foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* **Engineering Excellence \& Governance:**  

Establish best practices for code quality, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, performance tuning, and security compliance. Lead code reviews, architecture reviews, and technical audits.
* **Performance, Scalability \& Reliability:**  

Proactively monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and scalability for high\-traffic, business\-critical e\-commerce platforms.
* **Innovation \& Modernization:**  

Evaluate and implement modern technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns (e.g., headless commerce, microservices, cloud\-native solutions) to future\-proof the platform.
* **Stakeholder Communication \& Delivery Ownership:**  

Take ownership of technical delivery, manage risks, provide estimations, and communicate effectively with stakeholders, ensuring alignment on timelines, scope, and quality expectations.

v 8\+ years of E\-Commerce development with at least 6 years in SAP Hybris Commerce / SAP Cloud Commerce.


v Hands on Experience on SAP Hybris Core Architecture, Backoffice Cockpits, Impex, SmartEdit and PCM/Backoffice Customization


v Knowledge of Zul backend development and Solr search index build / querying


v Hybris Item Types and Catalog Management: In\-depth knowledge of product information management and catalog structures.


v Understanding of order processes, payment, shipping, and returns. Knowledge of customer profiles, segmentation, and personalization. Understanding of discount mechanisms, pricing rules, and promotions.


v Experience integrating Hybris with external systems (ERP, CRM, PIM, etc.).


v Java, J2EE (Servlets, JSP, JDBC, JMS, Transactions), Restful API, JSON, XML/XSLT, Java script, Angular / React


v Experience on open\-source tools and frameworks: Spring, Hibernate, ANT, MAVEN, JUNIT.


v Good knowledge and understanding of DOM, HTML, CSS and JavaScript OOP, MVC, Responsive, Javacript/Jquery and object\-oriented concepts.


v Experience on either of Application Servers – JBOSS, Tomcat.


v Experience working with Apache/Nginix.


v Knowledge and understanding of relational database structure and design using Azure Sql server / Oracle / PostgreSql


v Proficiency in Git for code management and collaboration.


v Understanding of unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing frameworks.

title: Principal Engineer, AI Platform Software Architecture
description:

------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Software Engineering
**General Summary:**

At Qualcomm, you will join a global leader in semiconductor technology and help shape the future of AI at the edge. You will work alongside world\-class engineers, architects, and product leaders to define the software architecture that enables AI experiences across a diverse range of products, including wearables, smartphones, XR devices, automotive platforms, edge computing systems, and AI PCs.


The Core Platform Software Architecture team is seeking an experienced and highly influential Principal Engineer, AI Platform Software Architecture to drive the software and system architecture for next\-generation AI inferencing platforms. In this role, you will lead cross\-functional architectural initiatives spanning software, hardware, security, memory systems, and AI accelerators while helping shape the long\-term technology strategy for Qualcomm's AI platform roadmap.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  

  

* 4\+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C\+\+, Java, Python, etc.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader responsible for influencing software and silicon architecture decisions across multiple product lines and future generations of AI platforms.


\-


Key Responsibilities


* Define and drive the long\-term platform software architecture and technical strategy for AI inferencing across Qualcomm's portfolio of edge AI products, influencing technology investments and architectural decisions across multiple product generations.
* Lead cross\-functional architectural initiatives involving software, hardware, AI accelerator, security, and product teams to deliver scalable and differentiated AI platform solutions.
* Collaborate with product management, customers, and silicon architecture teams to understand emerging AI workloads, product requirements, and technology trends, and translate them into platform architecture and roadmap recommendations.
* Drive hardware/software co\-design and influence future platform capabilities through architectural analysis, technical proposals, and strategic technology planning.
* Lead system\-level architecture and engineering efforts spanning operating systems, AI runtimes, memory systems, virtualization, security, interconnects, and heterogeneous compute architectures.
* Evaluate architectural alternatives, perform tradeoff analysis, and develop architecture proposals and specifications that balance performance, power, scalability, security, and product requirements.
* Drive alignment across organizations through architecture reviews, technical leadership, and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor and influence engineers and architects across the company while helping establish architectural best practices, technical standards, and long\-term technology direction.

\-


Preferred Qualifications


* 15\+ years of experience architecting complex embedded, platform, or systems software solutions.
* Demonstrated success driving architecture and technical strategy across multiple product generations and organizations.
* Strong experience in hardware/software interface design, system architecture, and end\-to\-end platform engineering.
* Deep expertise in several of the following areas:

o SoC and computer architecture


o ARM and RISC\-V architectures


o Linux kernel, operating systems, and device drivers


o Memory management and memory subsystem architecture


o DMA, IOMMU, and system interconnect technologies


o Virtualization and hypervisor technologies


o Security architecture, trusted execution environments, attestation, confidential computing, and model protection


o AI inferencing runtimes, frameworks, compilers, and software stacks


o Large Language Models (LLMs), Transformer architectures, and modern AI workloads


o Heterogeneous computing systems involving CPUs, GPUs, DSPs, NPUs, and dedicated AI accelerators


* Proven ability to influence senior technical leaders and drive consensus across geographically distributed teams.

title: Lead/Senior Solution Architect - AI Modernisation
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We’re looking for a **Lead/Senior Solution Architect** to join our growing team in India and help design cutting\-edge solutions for global clients.


We are seeking an experienced Lead/Senior professional with deep specialization in AI technologies and Application Modernisation to lead the design and delivery of transformative AI solutions. This role combines technical expertise in AI architecture with practical experience in modernising legacy systems and evolving enterprise platforms.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop AI\-driven solutions and agentic platforms that deliver measurable business value
* Lead application modernisation initiatives that incorporate AI technologies to enhance and transform existing systems
* Assess legacy systems and recommend modernisation strategies
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Implement and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models for enterprise applications
* Conduct research to stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in AI technologies and modernisation patterns
* Design migration pathways from monolithic to microservices, cloud\-native, or AI\-enabled architectures
* Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing systems and platforms
* Communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders to present solutions and gather feedback

**Requirements**

* 14\+ years of general IT experience, including proven experience as a Solution Architect, particularly in AI technologies and application modernisation
* Hands\-on experience with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models in production environments
* Demonstrated expertise in application modernisation, including legacy system assessment, refactoring strategies, and monolith\-to\-microservices transformation
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong research skills to stay abreast of the latest AI trends, modernisation patterns, and technologies
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Proficiency in English at an Upper\-Intermediate level (B2\) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Experience with other AI and machine learning frameworks and tools
* Previous experience in developing agentic platforms
* Familiarity with containerization, orchestration, and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Background in cloud migration and cloud\-native architecture design
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware technologies

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
